faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our teas, orders, delivery, and payments
faq.helpText: Our team is happy to help with any question about your order or our teas.

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We ship directly to all GCC nations (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar) as well as worldwide international delivery.
GCC delivery typically takes between 2 to 5 business days. Exact delivery estimates appear at checkout.

items.q: How is the shipping cost calculated?
items.a: Shipping depends on the destination country you choose. You'll see the cost and estimated delivery time before you pay.
VAT is added according to your delivery country and is itemized in your order summary before payment.
We support secure payments including mada, Apple Pay, Visa, MasterCard, and Stripe.

items.q: Which currency will I pay in?
items.a: For GCC deliveries you pay in your local currency. For the rest of the world, payment is in US dollars.
Payments are processed by trusted, encrypted payment gateways, and we never store your card details on our servers.

items.q: How do I get a refund for a cancelled order?
items.a: When a paid order is cancelled, the amount is refunded automatically to your original payment method. How soon it appears depends on your bank.

items.q: Can I order without creating an account?
items.a: Yes. You can check out as a guest with your email and shipping address. An account lets you track orders and save a wishlist.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: Sign in and open "My Orders" to see the status and progress of each order.
You can cancel from the order details page while it's awaiting payment or confirmed, before we start preparing it.

items.q: When can I review a product?
items.a: You can write a review only after your order has been delivered. It appears once our team has approved it.

items.q: How do you ensure tea freshness and aroma?
items.a: All our teas are packaged in specialized airtight, light-blocking tins and bags that seal in aromatic oils and peak freshness.

items.q: How should I store tea once opened?
items.a: Keep it in its airtight container, away from light, moisture and strong odors, in a cool, dry place.
